name: Vada Pav
instructions: 1. Prepare a tempering of mustard seeds, curry leaves, ginger-garlic paste, and green chilies, then mix with mashed potatoes and turmeric.
2. Shape the potato mixture into medium-sized balls.
3. Prepare a smooth, thick batter using gram flour, water, salt, and a pinch of turmeric.
4. Dip potato balls into the batter and deep-fry in hot oil until crisp and golden.
5. Slit the pav horizontally, smear with dry garlic chutney, and place the hot vada in the center.
6. Serve immediately, typically accompanied by fried green chilies.
description: Often called the Indian burger, Vada Pav is the iconic street food of Mumbai. It originated in the 1960s as a convenient, affordable meal for the working class and has since become a quintessential symbol of Maharashtrian culinary identity.
